description: This file defines the MetricsInterface interface for collecting various metrics related to server operations, including database, WebSocket, cache, search, plugin, remote cluster, shared channels, job, replica lag, notifications, client performance, access control, auto-translation, and other system metrics.

methods.name: RegisterDBCollector
methods.description: Registers a database collector with the given database and name.

methods.name: UnregisterDBCollector
methods.description: Unregisters a database collector with the given database and name.

methods.name: IncrementPostCreate
methods.description: Increments the counter for post creation events.

methods.name: IncrementPostSentEmail
methods.description: Increments the counter for posts sent via email.

methods.name: IncrementPostSentPush
methods.description: Increments the counter for posts sent via push notifications.

methods.name: IncrementPostFileAttachment
methods.description: Increments the counter for post file attachments.

methods.name: ObserveClusterRequestDuration
methods.description: Records the duration of a cluster request.

methods.name: IncrementClusterEventType
methods.description: Increments the counter for a specific cluster event type.

methods.name: IncrementEtagHitCounter
methods.description: Increments the ETag hit counter for a route.

methods.name: IncrementEtagMissCounter
methods.description: Increments the ETag miss counter for a route.

methods.name: IncrementMemCacheHitCounter
methods.description: Increments the memcache hit counter for a cache.

methods.name: IncrementMemCacheMissCounter
methods.description: Increments the memcache miss counter for a cache.

methods.name: IncrementMemCacheInvalidationCounter
methods.description: Increments the memcache invalidation counter for a cache.

methods.name: IncrementMemCacheMissCounterSession
methods.description: Increments the memcache miss counter for session cache.

methods.name: IncrementMemCacheHitCounterSession
methods.description: Increments the memcache hit counter for session cache.

methods.name: IncrementMemCacheInvalidationCounterSession
methods.description: Increments the memcache invalidation counter for session cache.

methods.name: IncrementWebSocketBroadcastBufferSize
methods.description: Increments the WebSocket broadcast buffer size.

methods.name: DecrementWebSocketBroadcastBufferSize
methods.description: Decrements the WebSocket broadcast buffer size.

methods.name: IncrementWebSocketBroadcastUsersRegistered
methods.description: Increments the count of registered WebSocket users.

methods.name: DecrementWebSocketBroadcastUsersRegistered
methods.description: Decrements the count of registered WebSocket users.

methods.name: IncrementWebsocketReconnectEventWithDisconnectErrCode
methods.description: Increments reconnect events with disconnect error code.

methods.name: IncrementHTTPWebSockets
methods.description: Increments active HTTP WebSocket connections for a client.

methods.name: DecrementHTTPWebSockets
methods.description: Decrements active HTTP WebSocket connections for a client.

methods.name: AddMemCacheHitCounter
methods.description: Adds to the memcache hit counter.

methods.name: AddMemCacheMissCounter
methods.description: Adds to the memcache miss counter.

methods.name: ObservePostsSearchDuration
methods.description: Records the duration of posts search.

methods.name: ObserveFilesSearchDuration
methods.description: Records the duration of files search.

methods.name: ObserveAPIEndpointDuration
methods.description: Records duration of API endpoint calls.

methods.name: GetLoggerMetricsCollector
methods.description: Returns the metrics collector for logging.

methods.name: IncrementRemoteClusterMsgSentCounter
methods.description: Increments remote cluster message sent counter.

methods.name: IncrementRemoteClusterMsgReceivedCounter
methods.description: Increments remote cluster message received counter.

methods.name: IncrementRemoteClusterMsgErrorsCounter
methods.description: Increments remote cluster message error counter.

methods.name: IncrementRemoteClusterConnStateChangeCounter
methods.description: Increments remote cluster connection state change counter.

methods.name: ObserveSharedChannelsTaskInQueueDuration
methods.description: Records shared channels task queue duration.

methods.name: ObserveSharedChannelsSyncCollectionStepDuration
methods.description: Records shared channels collection step duration.

methods.name: ObserveSharedChannelsSyncSendStepDuration
methods.description: Records shared channels send step duration.

methods.name: ObserveClientTimeToFirstByte
methods.description: Records client time to first byte.

methods.name: ObserveClientTimeToLastByte
methods.description: Records client time to last byte.

methods.name: ObserveClientTimeToDomInteractive
methods.description: Records client time to DOM interactive.

methods.name: ObserveMobileClientChannelSwitchDuration
methods.description: Records mobile client channel switch duration.

methods.name: ObserveMobileClientTeamSwitchDuration
methods.description: Records mobile client team switch duration.

methods.name: ObserveMobileClientNetworkRequestsAverageSpeed
methods.description: Records mobile network requests average speed.

methods.name: ObserveMobileClientNetworkRequestsEffectiveLatency
methods.description: Records mobile network requests effective latency.

methods.name: ObserveMobileClientNetworkRequestsElapsedTime
methods.description: Records mobile network requests elapsed time.

methods.name: ObserveMobileClientNetworkRequestsTotalCompressedSize
methods.description: Records total compressed size of mobile network requests.

methods.name: ObserveMobileClientNetworkRequestsTotalSize
methods.description: Records total size of mobile network requests.

methods.name: ObserveAccessControlSearchQueryDuration
methods.description: Records access control search query duration.

methods.name: ObserveAccessControlExpressionCompileDuration
methods.description: Records access control expression compile duration.

methods.name: IncrementAccessControlCacheInvalidation
methods.description: Increments access control cache invalidation counter.

methods.name: AddAutoTranslateRecoveryStuckFound
methods.description: Records number of stuck auto-translate recoveries.
